name: qikzo-monorepo
description: Qikzo — on-demand delivery & ride booking platform (server + customer app + rider app + admin dashboard). Root scripts proxy to the admin dashboard for the Lovable preview.

scripts.dev: cd Qikzo-admin-dashboard && npm install --silent && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
scripts.build: cd Qikzo-admin-dashboard && npm install --silent && npm run build
scripts.build:dev: cd Qikzo-admin-dashboard && npm install --silent && npm run build
